link_power_management_states.name: Active
link_power_management_states.description: Normal operation. TX + RX both active; TLPs / DLLPs / Ordered Sets flow freely.

link_power_management_states.name: Standby per direction
link_power_management_states.description: Either TX or RX direction enters Electrical Idle independently. Entry preceded by EIOS. Exit by transmitting N_FTS Fast Training Sequences. Per-direction independent.

link_power_management_states.name: Lower-power link standby
link_power_management_states.description: Both directions in Electrical Idle. Link state preserved; no full re-training. Exit via Recovery (Recovery.RcvrLock → Recovery.RcvrCfg → Recovery.Idle → L0).
link_power_management_states.exit_latency_estimate: single-digit microseconds (depends on Common Clock vs Separate Clock)

link_power_management_states.name: Deep sleep
link_power_management_states.description: Both directions in Electrical Idle. Main power may remain; REFCLK may be off. Wake via Beacon (or WAKE# at system level). LTSSM restarts from Detect.

link_power_management_states.name: Off
link_power_management_states.description: Main power removed. Re-entry requires full PERST# cycle.

low_power_modes_summary.L0s_standby: Per-direction Electrical Idle; sub-µs FTS-based exit.
low_power_modes_summary.L1_low: Bi-directional Electrical Idle; Link state preserved; few-µs Recovery-based exit.
low_power_modes_summary.L2_sleep: Deep sleep; REFCLK off; Beacon wakeup; ms-scale re-train.

device_states_d0_d3.description: Fully operational; corresponds to L0 link state.
Optional intermediate low-power; vendor-defined; functional but reduced.
Configuration Space still accessible; aux power only; corresponds to L1 or L2.
Main power removed; only Vaux available; corresponds to L2 / L3.

active_state_power_management_aspm.ASPM_L0s_support: Optional but commonly implemented; per-direction TX entry decision based on configurable idle threshold.
active_state_power_management_aspm.ASPM_L1_support: Optional; bi-directional agreement required via PM_Active_State_Request_L1 DLLP.
active_state_power_management_aspm.ASPM_disable: Default; can be enabled per-direction via Link Control Register.

pm_messages_summary.name: PM_Request_Ack
pm_messages_summary.purpose: DLLP acknowledging a PM_Enter_L1 / PM_Enter_L23 request.

pm_messages_summary.name: PM_PME (TLP Message)
pm_messages_summary.purpose: Power Management Event message; routed upstream to the Root Complex.

pm_messages_summary.name: PME_Turn_Off / PME_TO_Ack (TLP Messages)
pm_messages_summary.purpose: Root informs downstream devices of imminent main-power removal; devices acknowledge.

auxiliary_power.Vaux_support: Optional auxiliary power rail supplied to devices for PME / WAKE# generation while main power is off (L2/L3, D3cold).
auxiliary_power.Vaux_usage_hint: Required for any device that must generate a wake event from D3cold.

fields.notes: PCI Express explicitly specifies a comprehensive Link Power Management framework: ASPM (HW-driven L0s + L1) for autonomous power saving during idle, plus software-driven L1/L2/L3 transitions for OS / firmware control. Coordination with the legacy PCI Power Management Capability (D0..D3) is mandatory — see Section 6.3 PCI-PM Software Compatible Mechanisms.

isolation_supply_partitioning.robust_long_distance_topology: Per-node isolated DC/DC converter feeds the local transceiver bus-side supply; digital isolator separates data signals across the isolation barrier; supplies up to 150 Mbps modern isolation devices, 3 V to 5 V regulated outputs.
isolation_supply_partitioning.single_ground_reference: When multiple isolated transceivers share a bus, one non-isolated transceiver provides the single-ground reference for the entire bus (Figure 11-3 of SLLA272D).

fields.esd_protection_examples: Modern TI RS-485 transceivers integrate IEC 61000-4-2 / HBM ESD protection from 16 kV to 30 kV on bus pins.

extraction_hints: Look for power-domain partitioning, supply nets.
